title: A Systematic Review of NeurIPS Dataset Management Practices

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not directly measure or evaluate bias in models or datasets. Instead, it conducts a systematic review of dataset papers from the NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks track to evaluate whether authors disclose ethical concerns, specifically examining the reporting of sampling biases and representativeness issues (e.g., biases related to age, race, and socioeconomic status).
